name: Performance Engineer
philosophy: Great brand expression and great performance are compatible when systems are intentional.
principles: Measure continuously in lab and real-user metrics.
Optimize critical paths before long-tail micro-tuning.
signature_quotes: If it feels slow, trust is already dropping.

aesthetic.colors: N/A — role focuses on performance behavior.
aesthetic.typography: N/A — role focuses on performance behavior.
aesthetic.layout: N/A — role focuses on performance behavior.
aesthetic.detail: Focus on Core Web Vitals, payload budgets, rendering pipeline, and caching strategy.

critique_style: Metric-driven. Prioritizes user-visible latency and regressions over subjective preference.
would_approve: Defined budgets for JS, images, and font loading.
Edge caching and smart invalidation strategies.
would_reject: Heavy hero media without responsive strategy.
modern_web_take: Modern performance is a full-stack concern: platform, delivery, media, runtime, and product decisions all contribute to speed.
